item.title: 3x3x3 LED Cube
item.description: This is where it all started — 27 LEDs, floating in space, somehow behaving like one tiny 3D display.

item.title: 4x4x4 LED Cube
item.description: 64 LEDs. The same core concept as the first build, but the logic and wiring density are completely unforgiving. Fully stable and running complete 3D patterns.

item.title: 9x9x9 LED Cube
item.description: 729 LEDs. At this point, I wasn’t really making an LED cube anymore. I was building a problem. :}
